summary: 1936 timber tower 15 miles north of Enterprise, Oregon; unstaffed since the early 1970s, privately owned, NHLR-listed 1997. Sources disagree on builder, cab size and sale year.

access.note: Privately owned by Brian Wizard; NHLR and firelookout.com both describe it as private property

corrections.why: NHLR describes a 103-foot tower and the state record says 103 feet high; 103 ft is about 31.4 m. The 2.1 m value is not supported by any source.
NHLR lists Wizard as owner of a privately held tower, not an administering agency.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR and cherylhill.net credit the Forest Service with the 1936 build. The state record names the CCC as builder. The sources do not reconcile these, so the story reports both.
NHLR gives an 8 by 8 ft L-6 cab; firelookout.com gives 7 by 7 ft. Not resolved; the story reports both.
firelookout.com gives a 1978 state auction; cherylhill.net gives a 1984 ODF auction. Not resolved; the story reports both.
firelookout.com ties the ground house to the 1936 build. cherylhill.net reports the owner saying the living quarters date to the 1960s. Not resolved.

notes_for_editor: Four sources, all agreeing on the 1936 build and the 1997 NHLR listing, but disagreeing on builder (Forest Service vs CCC), cab size (8x8 vs 7x7), and sale year (1978 vs 1984). Brief height 2.1 m was wrong; the tower is 103 ft. Not read: the Forest Lookouts page for Tope Creek (oregonlookouts.weebly.com; a search snippet cites a 1936 Forest Log item, unverified) and the Wizard 2001 Lookout Network article mentioned by cherylhill.net. No rental information found. The state record's second date (c.1992) is unexplained. Public access is not described; keep the story's advice to check with the owner.
